paper_title: A deep search for decaying dark matter with XMM-Newton blank-sky observations
notes: The paper's headline measured result (Fig. 3) is a power-constrained 95% upper limit on the sterile-neutrino mixing angle sin^2(2theta) (equivalently the decaying-DM lifetime) versus DM mass m_chi over 5-16 keV, from XMM-Newton blank-sky observations. This is a decaying sterile-neutrino DM search; the constrained quantity (sin^2(2theta) / DM lifetime) does not correspond to any coupling in the AxionLimitBench canonical table (AxionPhoton, AxionElectron, DarkPhoton, etc.). The paper notes in passing that axion-like-particle DM and moduli DM predict similar unassociated X-ray line signatures, but it does NOT present an axion-photon (or other listed) coupling limit as its result. Hence out of scope: is_new_limit=false, coupling_type=null. dm_density_assumed=0.29 GeV/cm^3 is the local DM density from the fiducial NFW profile used (r_0=6.6e6 Msun/kpc^3, r_s=19.1 kpc), reported for reference only. No data points emitted.
